x: Our sole representative in the Boys 3,000m was Kevin McDermot, a newcomer who clocked a creditable 17:11 for 17th. Kevin and his brother Trevor look tough and strong and are training with Ray Middleton who lives nearby - those Hendon roads will soon need re-surfacing.

Kevin and Trevor McDermot both competed in 1 mile events, being timed at 8:51 and 8:03 respectively. In the open 10Km event held at the Lugano Cup Final meeting, Milton Keynes on September 25th, Graham Seatter was below his best form and placed 16th in 47:34.
After the first of the seven laps Richard Dorman (Surrey) and Trevor McDermot (Mddx.) were in a group in 4th position. As the laps went by our two pulled away and it looked like 4th and 5th for us.

The second time in three years that we have won it and as a result congratulations go to Richard Dorman, Paul Blagg and Trevor McDermot and commiserations to the four behind them who, had they walked for other clubs, would have been in the scoring teams.

Making his debut over the distance was Trevor McDermot who walked the first half with Ray and then showed us what a prospect he is by dropping Ray (his second 10kms was faster than his first), to get under 110 minutes.

Richard came home in 2nd spot, five seconds up on Yorkshire's Elliott and with Paul 6th and Trevor McDermot closing the team in with 10th, Belgrave took the team race for the second time in three years.
A year ago it was predicted that Trevor McDermot would break the hour in the Enfield Open 7 miles walk - which he did. This year a similar prediction was made about Kevin - and he promptly obliged!
In the Senior Boys 10kms, 4th was Trevor McDermot in 50.20; and 12th P.Morris in 54.56. Junior Boys 3kms, 20th I.McDermot 16.40; 34.R.McCann 17.48; 38.S.Pritchard 17.59.
